# Bluebonnet Web

> Bluebonnet Web builds fast, phone-friendly, Google-ready websites for small local service businesses in the Austin, Texas area, at flat prices with an optional monthly care plan.

- Based in: Austin, Texas
- Serves: Austin, Lakeway, Bee Cave, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Pflugerville, Dripping Springs, Marble Falls

## Pages
- [Websites for Austin Small Businesses](https://meunierdeacon-blip.github.io/bluebonnet-web/): Fast, phone-friendly, Google-ready websites for Austin-area local service businesses. Flat pricing, live in about a week, optional monthly care.
- [Get a Free Website Quote](https://meunierdeacon-blip.github.io/bluebonnet-web/contact/): Tell us about your business and get a flat-price quote for a new website. Serving small businesses in Austin, Lakeway, Round Rock, Cedar Park, and nearby.
- [Website Pricing for Small Businesses](https://meunierdeacon-blip.github.io/bluebonnet-web/pricing/): Flat website pricing for Austin small businesses: Starter $400, Local SEO Site, and an optional monthly Care Plan. No hourly billing.
- [Free Small Business Website Check](https://meunierdeacon-blip.github.io/bluebonnet-web/website-check/): Eight quick questions to see if your small business website is losing customers. Takes 60 seconds, works on your phone, no email required.
